notes.title: Danger Ducklings releases at the end of Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Join 2 cute but not-so-bright ducklings on their quest through over 100 fun and challenging puzzles! Conquer new modes, collect costumes, and explore different worlds on their journey to reunite with their Mother!

Danger Ducklings' full release features a ton of content not present in the demo! Such as: 

[list]
[*] Worlds 2, 3, and their Mastery Levels! 
[*] Costumes that were not equitable in the demo! 
[*] Time Trial Mode: Race the clock to beat multiple levels in a row, and unlock concept art!
[*] The epic conclusion to the story of the game!  
[/list]

Danger Duckling's Demo is out now, and the full game releases June 26th!
